title: net1 v4 seeds: the two best width-512 settings, seeds 10 and 20
description: Confirms the choice of exp-net1v4-grid-10 and exp-net1v4-lr-12 (dropout 0.05 at width 512 and learning rate 1e-3, CRPS skill 0.780 on validation rows; dropout 0 next at 0.777) over two more ensemble seeds each. Seeds 10 and 20 keep every member's batch order apart from seed 0's (member i trains with seed + i). Ranked on validation rows with every earlier run.
run: uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/net1-d$DROPOUT-w512-s$SEED" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=$DROPOUT --set width=512 --seed $SEED --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" --ood competitors="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-competitors" --ood loss="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-loss" --ood rtt="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-rtt" --ood buffer="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-buffer" --compare "$IN/models/net1v3.pt"
